draw.note: Inside Darling State Park (parent); the CCC toll road reaches a 1912 fire tower, the first in Vermont.

standing.note: A strong drive-up view; Mount Pisgah and Willoughby are the Kingdom's headline views.

distinction.note: Mount Pisgah, Bald Mountain and other fire towers within 50 km.

easy_payoff.note: The toll road reaches the summit area; a short walk to the tower.

weather.note: A summit panorama needs clear air.

records.why: A drive-up summit and fire tower facing Willoughby Gap.

access_cost.note: A toll road; fee, season and private-event closures not published on the pages read.

wikidata.note: checked: coordinates and description on Wikidata match Smugglers' Notch State Park, 44.554 N 72.796 W, which holds the pass; the search returns the ski resort Q7546617 first

draw.note: Inside Smugglers' Notch State Park (parent); the state transportation agency closes the road each winter and bans long vehicles.

draw_peak.note: Pattern year 2026; the foliage window draws visitors from across the country.

standing.note: A dramatic pass; northern Vermont has several strong foliage drives.

distinction.note: Appalachian Gap and Lincoln Gap are the same class within 100 km.

easy_payoff.note: Seen from the road and the pull-offs.

weather.note: Cliffs and colour want clear light; the shaded slot is fine in overcast.

records.why: A narrow pass between cliffs on VT-108, at its best in fall colour.

v.note: VT-108 through the Notch closes each winter

designations.note: The pass lies inside the state park (Wikidata coordinates and the park name).
